properties.displayName: AuditEvent ASIM parser for Salesforce Audit Trail
properties.query:
let parser = (
    disabled: bool = false,
    pack: bool = false
) {
    SalesforceAuditTrail
    | where not(disabled)
    | extend SalesforceDomain = tostring(column_ifexists("SalesforceDomain", ""))
    | extend
        EventTime = coalesce(CreatedDate, TimeGenerated),
        ActorUsername = coalesce(
            CreatedByUsername,
            CreatedByEmail,
            CreatedByName),
        Operation = coalesce(Action, Display, "Salesforce audit event"),
        Object = coalesce(Section, Action, "Salesforce configuration"),
        EventTypeSource = tolower(strcat(Action, " ", Display))
    | extend EventType = case(
        EventTypeSource has_any ("created", "added", "inserted", "provisioned"), "Create",
        EventTypeSource has_any ("deleted", "removed", "deprovisioned"), "Delete",
        EventTypeSource has_any ("enabled", "activated", "unfrozen"), "Enable",
        EventTypeSource has_any ("disabled", "deactivated", "frozen"), "Disable",
        EventTypeSource has_any ("installed", "upgraded"), "Install",
        EventTypeSource has_any ("initialized", "initialised"), "Initialize",
        EventTypeSource has_any ("started", "launched"), "Start",
        EventTypeSource has_any ("stopped", "paused"), "Stop",
        EventTypeSource has_any ("terminated", "killed"), "Terminate",
        EventTypeSource has_any ("cleared", "reset", "purged"), "Clear",
        EventTypeSource has_any ("executed", "invoked", "ran"), "Execute",
        EventTypeSource has_any ("viewed", "read", "downloaded", "exported"), "Read",
        "Set")
    | invoke _ASIM_ResolveFQDN('SalesforceDomain')
    | extend
        EventUid = coalesce(
            Id,
            hash_sha256(strcat(
                TenantId, "|",
                tostring(EventTime), "|",
                CreatedById, "|",
                Action, "|",
                Section, "|",
                Display))),
        ActorUsernameType = _ASIM_GetUsernameType(ActorUsername),
        ActorUserType = case(
            CreatedByContext =~ "User", "Regular",
            isempty(CreatedByContext), "",
            "Other"),
        TargetAppName = iff(
            isnotempty(SalesforceDomain),
            SalesforceDomain,
            "Salesforce"),
        AdditionalFields = iff(
            pack,
            bag_pack(
                "CreatedByIssuer", CreatedByIssuer,
                "CreatedByName", CreatedByName,
                "DelegateUser", DelegateUser,
                "SourceSystem", SourceSystem,
                "CreatedDate", CreatedDate,
                "TenantId", TenantId,
                "_BilledSize", _BilledSize,
                "_IsBillable", _IsBillable
            ),
            dynamic({}))
    | project-rename
        ActorOriginalUserType = CreatedByContext,
        ActorUserId = CreatedById,
        ActorUserUpn = CreatedByEmail,
        EventOriginalUid = Id
    | project
        TimeGenerated,
        Type = "SalesforceAuditTrail",
        EventCount = toint(1),
        EventEndTime = EventTime,
        EventMessage = Display,
        EventOriginalResultDetails = "",
        EventOriginalSubType = Section,
        EventOriginalType = Action,
        EventOriginalUid,
        EventProduct = "Salesforce Audit Trail",
        EventResult = "Success",
        EventResultDetails = "",
        EventSchema = "AuditEvent",
        EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0",
        EventSeverity = "Informational",
        EventStartTime = EventTime,
        EventSubType = Section,
        EventType,
        EventUid,
        EventVendor = "Salesforce",
        ActingAppName = "Salesforce Setup",
        ActingAppType = "SaaS application",
        ActingApplicationEntityKey = "",
        ActorOriginalUserType,
        ActorUserAdditionalIds = dynamic([]),
        ActorUserEntityKey = "",
        ActorUserId,
        ActorUserIdType = iff(
            isnotempty(ActorUserId),
            "SalesforceId",
            ""),
        ActorUsername,
        ActorUsernameType,
        ActorUserType,
        ActorUserUpn,
        AdditionalEntities = dynamic([]),
        AdditionalFields,
        Application = TargetAppName,
        Dst = coalesce(FQDN, tostring(ExtractedHostname), TargetAppName),
        Dvc = "Salesforce Audit Trail",
        DvcAction = "Allowed",
        DvcDescription = "Salesforce setup audit trail service",
        DvcDomain = "",
        DvcDomainType = "",
        DvcEntityKey = "",
        DvcFQDN = "",
        DvcHostname = "",
        NewValue = "",
        Object,
        ObjectType = "Configuration Atom",
        OldValue = "",
        Operation,
        OriginalObjectType = Section,
        Src = "",
        SrcHostname = "",
        SrcIpAddr = "",
        SrcSystemEntityKey = "",
        TargetApplicationEntityKey = "",
        TargetAppName,
        TargetAppType = "SaaS application",
        TargetDescription = Display,
        TargetDomain = tostring(Domain),
        TargetDomainType = DomainType,
        TargetFQDN = FQDN,
        TargetHostname = tostring(ExtractedHostname),
        TargetSystemEntityKey = "",
        TargetUrl = iff(
            isnotempty(SalesforceDomain),
            strcat("https://", SalesforceDomain),
            ""),
        User = ActorUsername,
        Value = "",
        ValueType = ""
};
parser(disabled=disabled, pack=pack)
